data.gender_notes: Dhamendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhamendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Dhama’ meaning cosmos or universe, and ‘Andra’ meaning thunder. It is the name of the Hindu god Indra, who is considered the god of rain and thunder. The name Dhamendra carries the meaning “God of Thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhamendra usually hope their child will grow to embody god of thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
